question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic secant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arsech}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{x\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[4\operatorname{arsech}⁡(\sqrt[4]{x})] \\  & =4\cdot [-\frac{1}{\sqrt[4]{x}\sqrt{1-{(\sqrt[4]{x})}^{2}}}]\cdot {(\sqrt[4]{x})}^{′} \\  & =-\frac{4}{\sqrt[4]{x}\sqrt{1-\sqrt{x}}}\cdot \frac{1}{4\sqrt[4]{{x}^{3}}} \\  & =-\frac{1}{x\sqrt{1-\sqrt{x}}}.\end{aligned}
$$
